cards.summary: Long COVID: High chart pattern, 6.1× the post-COVID average. Review the dated findings.
cards.detail:
**Chart pattern similar to adults later coded with Long COVID.**

Estimated probability, as of day 90, of a Long COVID code 91 to 455 days after COVID-19: 6.2% (6.1× the average for adults 90 days after COVID-19). Band: High (a descriptive score category, not a validated action threshold).

Top findings in the chart:

1. 3+ symptom types coded in days 31-90 (2024-02-20, 2024-03-05, 2024-03-25)
2. Personal history of COVID-19 coded (days 31-90) (2024-03-12)
3. COVID-19 still coded at a follow-up visit (days 31-90) (2024-02-20)

Next step: Review the dated findings and ask the patient to complete the RECOVER symptom list, the DePaul post-exertional malaise screen, and the PCFS functional status grade. If the review supports post-COVID illness, consider a post-COVID clinic referral or clinical trial screening.

Research decision support. Surfaces chart patterns for clinician review. Not a diagnosis. Model unm-longcovid 1.2.0.
